name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v543: WebView cache clearing + forced challenge load. (1) WebView cache is now cleared before loading to force fresh Cloudflare challenge. (2) Both visible and headless modes now force challenge page load for API endpoints. (3) Cloudflare cookies are purged from jar before loading to force fresh challenge. (4) Fixed toggle inversion - bypass now respects visible/invisible setting correctly. (5) probeAndResolveIfNeeded waits for bypass to complete before returning. (6) All v542 fixes retained: 30s fail-fast timeout for headless, isUsableClearance accepts existing token, always require cf_clearance, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, Domain=.host cookie clearing.
